title: ficus benguetensis f. negrosensis
intro: Ficus benguetensis f. negrosensis, commonly known as the Negros Island ficus, is a species of fig tree that is native to the Philippines. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Ficus benguetensis f. negrosensis include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, cell damage, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
